searchText: <trent_vanepps> we're looking to start a call this week or next week. it will run at least for the next few months, to give a synchronous space for people directly contributing to this project to accommodate the relevant contributors, it would have to be around 11:30 UTC (21:30 AEST, 13:30 CET 7:30 EST), let's aim for Thursdays (every two weeks?) first question - <@405860945018093609> do evenings work for you? another alternative is we focus on 2/3 timezones and then rotate <dannyryan> If and how to upgrade the ceremony at future hard forks is a bit of an open question — can you do so in way that facilitates applications being able to upgrade trustlessly? Two options 1. some sort of versioning inside the EVM so past and present commitments are available 2. a proof of continunity of commitment to be given to individual applications to allow them to trustlessly migrate to new commitment (h/t @CarlBeek) Both are worth considering a bit more in the coming months because extending the ceremony is certainly valuable <dankrad> can't we already support this using the versioned hashes? <dankrad> the updated ceremony would simply get a new version <trent_vanepps> i guess there's also the separate questions about the social / process infra about soliciting or accepting new contributions, running the coordinating server in perpetuity <CarlBeek> the idea would be to upgrade it every 5 years or so just to keep the list of contributors fresh. i think we can eat the process costs on that timescale

excerpts.content:
<trent_vanepps> we're looking to start a call this week or next week. it will run at least for the next few months, to give a synchronous space for people directly contributing to this project

to accommodate the relevant contributors, it would have to be around 11:30 UTC (21:30 AEST, 13:30 CET 7:30 EST), let's aim for Thursdays (every two weeks?)

first question - <@405860945018093609> do evenings work for you? another alternative is we focus on 2/3 timezones and then rotate

excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<dannyryan> If and how to upgrade the ceremony at future hard forks is a bit of an open question — can you do so in way that facilitates applications being able to upgrade trustlessly?

Two options
1. some sort of versioning inside the EVM so past and present commitments are available
2. a proof of continunity of commitment to be given to individual applications to allow them to trustlessly migrate to new commitment (h/t @CarlBeek)

Both are worth considering a bit more in the coming months because extending the ceremony is certainly valuable
